hikes.name: Hoh River Trail to Five Mile Island
hikes.blurb: Flat miles through the moss-draped Hoh Rain Forest beside a milky glacial river, elk likely.

hikes.name: Hall of Mosses
hikes.blurb: A short loop under maples hung with curtains of moss, the rain forest at its most magical.

hikes.name: Rialto Beach to Hole-in-the-Wall
hikes.blurb: Along a driftwood beach to a sea arch with tide pools; check the tide before going through.

hikes.name: Third Beach
hikes.blurb: Through forest to a long cove with a waterfall dropping straight onto the sand at the far end.

hikes.name: Ozette Triangle
hikes.blurb: Cedar boardwalks to the coast, three miles of beach past ancient petroglyphs, then back through the forest.

hikes.name: Sol Duc Falls
hikes.blurb: An easy old-growth walk to a falls splitting into several streams into a narrow slot.

hikes.name: Deer Lake
hikes.blurb: Past Sol Duc Falls and up Canyon Creek's cascades to a forest lake, the gateway to the High Divide.

hikes.name: Spruce Railroad Trail and Devil's Punchbowl
hikes.blurb: Along Lake Crescent's old railroad grade to a footbridge over a clear, deep cove.

hikes.name: Pyramid Mountain
hikes.blurb: Climbing from Lake Crescent's north shore to a wartime aircraft-spotting cabin above the lake.
